name: MakeAIVideo API
description:
Public v1 API for MakeAIVideo: turn a brief or your own script into a finished short-form video (script, voiceover, AI or stock scenes, captions, music), edit and regenerate parts of it, and fetch the MP4. Everything the product can do, agents can do.

## Authentication
All endpoints except the device-login pair accept an API key:
```
Authorization: Bearer mav_...
```
Create keys under Settings, Advanced, API keys, or with `makeaivideo login` (CLI device flow). Keys carry scopes (`read`, `write`, `ai`); each operation lists its scope under `x-scope`. `read` lists and inspects; `write` creates, edits, regenerates, deletes (and spends credits); `ai` covers generation helpers (scripts, ideas, portraits, previews, music). A missing scope returns `403 forbidden`.

## Envelope
Every JSON response is `{ data, error, meta }`. On failure `data` is null and `error` is `{ message, code, retryable, details? }`. `retryable` is true only for 5xx and 429; never retry a 4xx without changing the request. Two endpoints return files instead of JSON: `GET /videos/{id}/captions`.

## The core loop
1. `GET /tools` (what we can make). 2. `POST /videos/estimate` (free quote). 3. `POST /videos` with `tool` + `fields`, or with your own `script` (202, `video_id`). 4. Poll `GET /videos/{id}` respecting `poll_after_seconds`, or subscribe to `video.ready` with `POST /webhooks`. 5. `GET /videos/{id}/download`.

Renders take minutes. Set `idempotency_key` on create so a retry never produces (and charges for) a second video.

## Publishing to social accounts
Post finished videos to the workspace's connected accounts: TikTok, Instagram (as a Reel), YouTube (9:16 as a Short, 16:9 as a regular video), Facebook Pages, LinkedIn, X (videos up to 140 seconds), Threads, Pinterest, Bluesky, Telegram and Discord.
1. `GET /publishing/accounts` lists connected accounts (`acc_...` ids, `can_post`, `needs_reconnection`), the plan's account limit and every platform. 2. To add an OAuth account, `POST /publishing/accounts/connect` returns a short-lived `url` that a PERSON must open in a browser and approve; an agent cannot complete it. Bluesky, Telegram and Discord connect with credentials in the web app only (the Accounts page). 3. `POST /videos/{id}/publish` with `account_ids` and `caption` answers 202 with a post (`pub_...`); set `idempotency_key` so a retry never posts twice. 4. Poll `GET /publishing/posts/{id}` until `done` is true, or subscribe to `post.published`, `post.partially_failed` and `post.failed`. Each destination carries its own `status`, live `url` and `error`.
A workspace where publishing is not switched on gets `403 publishing_unavailable` (not retryable).

## Webhooks
`POST /webhooks` with a public https URL and events. Every delivery is signed: `X-MakeAIVideo-Signature: sha256=<HMAC-SHA256(raw body, secret)>`, with `X-MakeAIVideo-Event`, `X-MakeAIVideo-Event-Id` (dedup key), `X-MakeAIVideo-Timestamp` and `X-MakeAIVideo-Attempt`. Non-2xx responses retry at 30s, 2m, 10m, 1h, 6h, then stop. Twenty consecutive failures disable the webhook until you PATCH `is_active: true`.
Events: `video.created`, `video.ready`, `video.failed`, `character.created`, and for publishing `post.published` (every destination went out), `post.partially_failed` and `post.failed`. A `post.*` event's `data` is the same Post object `GET /publishing/posts/{id}` returns. A post can emit a second outcome if a failed destination is retried later.
